Questions: are the cross-validation AUROC of each algorithm, the AUROC on the test cohort and
the top predictive features the same as in the ground truth? Nothing else is compared.

```{r}
source("evaluation/Comparison/helpers.R")
library(pROC)
```

## Load the results of each run

Each run saved a copy of its results in `results/standard/`: the cross-validation AUROC of the
algorithms it compared, its predictions for the test cohort, the importance of each feature and
the composition of the subgroups that are features of its model (needed to identify them).

```{r}
load("evaluation/Groundtruth/Scenario3/Results/ML_analysis_results.RData")  # res, pred, shap_classification

riaz_samples = clean_id(rownames(read.csv("evaluation/Groundtruth/Scenario3/Results/Deconvolution_Riaz.csv", row.names = 1)))

subgroups_by_celltype = res$Custom_output[["Deconvolution subgroups composition"]]
gt_subgroups = stack(do.call(c, unname(subgroups_by_celltype)))

subgroups  = list("Groundtruth" = data.frame(subgroup = as.character(gt_subgroups$ind), feature = gt_subgroups$values))
cv         = list("Groundtruth" = data.frame(algorithm = res$AUROC_median$model, cv_auroc = res$AUROC_median$Median_AUROC))
prediction = list("Groundtruth" = setNames(pred$Predictions$yes, riaz_samples))  # same order as the Riaz deconvolution
importance = list("Groundtruth" = colMeans(abs(as.matrix(shap_classification))))

for (r in agent_runs) {
  subgroups[[r]]  = read_subgroups(r, 3)
  cv[[r]]         = read.csv(standard_file(r, 3, "cv_performance.csv"))
  if (file.exists(standard_file(r, 3, "test_predictions.csv"))) {  # a run without external test has none
    prediction[[r]] = read_standard(r, 3, "test_predictions.csv")[, "probability_R"]
  }
  features        = read.csv(standard_file(r, 3, "feature_importance.csv"))
  importance[[r]] = setNames(features$importance, make.names(features$feature))
}
```

## Cross-validation AUROC of each algorithm

AUROC of each algorithm in the cross-validation on the training cohort.

```{r}
cv_table = data.frame(Algorithm = cv$Groundtruth$algorithm)
for (r in runs) cv_table[[r]] = cv[[r]]$cv_auroc[match(cv_table$Algorithm, cv[[r]]$algorithm)]
kable(cv_table, digits = 3)
```

An algorithm is reproduced when its AUROC is the same as in the ground truth (difference below
0.001). `Best_algorithm` is the one with the highest AUROC.

```{r}
best_algorithm = function(r) cv[[r]]$algorithm[which.max(cv[[r]]$cv_auroc)]

cv_score = by_run(function(r) {
  same = abs(cv_table[[r]] - cv_table$Groundtruth) < 0.001
  data.frame(GT = nrow(cv_table), Reproduced = sum(same, na.rm = TRUE), Score = sum(same, na.rm = TRUE) / nrow(cv_table),
             Best_algorithm = best_algorithm(r), Same_best_algorithm = best_algorithm(r) == best_algorithm("Groundtruth"))
})
kable(cv_score, digits = 2)
```

## AUROC on the test cohort

AUROC on Riaz, computed here from the predictions of each run (with 95% confidence interval).
A run without external test cohort has no value.

```{r}
riaz = load_coldata("Riaz")
response = setNames(riaz$Response, riaz$rna_id)

test_auroc = data.frame(Run = runs, Test_patients = 0, AUROC = NA, CI_low = NA, CI_high = NA, row.names = runs)

for (r in names(prediction)) {
  p = prediction[[r]]
  ci = ci.auc(roc(response[names(p)], p, levels = c("NR", "R"), direction = "<"))
  test_auroc[r, "Test_patients"] = length(p)
  test_auroc[r, c("CI_low", "AUROC", "CI_high")] = ci
}
test_auroc$Same_as_GT = !is.na(test_auroc$AUROC) & abs(test_auroc$AUROC - test_auroc["Groundtruth", "AUROC"]) < 0.001
kable(test_auroc, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)
```

## Top predictive features

The features of each model, by exact identity: a single deconvolution feature is its name, and
a subgroup is the set of its members (so two subgroups are the same feature only when they
contain the same raw features). `Present` = features of the ground-truth model that the model
of the run also has.

```{r}
feature_identity = function(features, composition) {
  group_members = members(composition, "subgroup", "feature")
  ifelse(features %in% names(group_members), group_members[features], features)
}

for (r in runs) names(importance[[r]]) = feature_identity(names(importance[[r]]), subgroups[[r]])

gt_importance = importance$Groundtruth

feature_score = by_run(function(r) data.frame(
  GT           = length(gt_importance),
  Present      = sum(names(gt_importance) %in% names(importance[[r]])),
  Top10_shared = length(intersect(top_names(importance[[r]], 10), top_names(gt_importance, 10))),
  Top20_shared = length(intersect(top_names(importance[[r]], 20), top_names(gt_importance, 20)))
))
kable(feature_score)
```

The ten most important features of the ground truth, and the runs that also have them in their
own top ten.

```{r}
top_table = data.frame(Feature = top_names(gt_importance, 10))
for (r in agent_runs) top_table[[r]] = ifelse(top_table$Feature %in% top_names(importance[[r]], 10), "yes", "")
kable(top_table)
```

## Summary

```{r}
#| fig-height: 3.5
#| fig-width: 10
summary_scores = rbind(
  data.frame(run = cv_score$Run, comparison = "CV AUROC per algorithm", score = cv_score$Score),
  data.frame(run = agent_runs, comparison = "AUROC on test cohort", score = as.numeric(test_auroc[agent_runs, "Same_as_GT"])),
  data.frame(run = feature_score$Run, comparison = "Top 10 features", score = feature_score$Top10_shared / 10),
  data.frame(run = feature_score$Run, comparison = "Top 20 features", score = feature_score$Top20_shared / 20)
)
summary_scores$run = factor(summary_scores$run, levels = agent_runs)
summary_scores$comparison = factor(summary_scores$comparison, levels = unique(summary_scores$comparison))

ggplot(summary_scores, aes(run, score, fill = arm_of(as.character(run)))) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(score, accuracy = 1)), vjust = -0.4, size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~comparison, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = arm_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.12), breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1), labels = scales::percent) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Reproduced from the ground truth", fill = NULL)

write.csv(summary_scores, "evaluation/Comparison/metrics/scores_Scenario3.csv", row.names = FALSE)
save_figure("Scenario3/scores", 10, 3.5)
```
